title: Ship
caption: The hull owns its layers; the Scene supplies the crew
intro: Compare the empty research ship, placement anchors, populated bridge and deck, mirrored hull and slow rock. Dots mark bridge seats, deck positions, the robot cradle and A-frame tip.
contract: Import Ship and shipAnchors from slide-shared/deep-sea-expedition/ship and ship.pure. The origin is the waterline amidships. Bridge figures sit behind window frames; deck figures sit behind the rail. Mirror the anchors when you flip the hull; use rock only on a Surface Scene.
